text:
2 former Parsippany High School athletes on college rosters for week ending Sept. 6
By
G. M. RivasTwo former Parsippany High School athletes are listed on college rosters for the week ending Sept. 6. Senior Victoria Bruno appears with Wagner's field hockey program, which is scheduled to host Hofstra on Sept. 4.
Field hockey and men's soccer are represented, with Wagner and New Jersey City the college teams listed. Those teams have three scheduled events during the week ending Sept. 6.
Each athlete's college team and scheduled events are listed below.
Former Parsippany High School Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Victoria Bruno
Wagner field hockey — NEC
Schedule: Hosts Hofstra on September 4 in Staten Island, NY; Hosts Temple on September 6 in Staten Island, NY
David Ferreira
New Jersey City men's soccer — NJAC
Schedule: Visits Saint Elizabeth University on September 6 in Morristown, NJ
